svg.aria-label: Converting mean radiant heat into an annual gas volume
svg.title: Converting mean radiant heat into an annual gas volume
svg.text: gas flared (billion m³ per year) = 0.0116 × MW
Ticks: the 492 sites seen flaring on clear nights, 6 Oct–4 Nov 2026. Together they average 759 MW,
which converts to 8.8 billion m³ a year. One megawatt held all year is 11.6 million m³ of gas.
